decompose_timeseries_STL: create a TimeSeriesDecomposition object with STL method to decompose time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components
decompose_timeseries_seasonal: build a TimeSeriesDecomposition using seasonal_decompose method to split time series data into additive or multiplicative components
plot_decomposition_results: run the plot method on TimeSeriesDecomposition to visualize original series alongside trend, seasonality, and residual subplots
remove_seasonality_handler: create a SeasonalityHandler to remove seasonality from time series data and return detrended non-seasonal components
get_seasonality_component: build a SeasonalityHandler to extract and return the seasonal component from multivariate or univariate time series data
